title: Tom DeLonge narrative of a Majestic-style controlling group

tellings.quote: basically the Tom Delong narrative right where he's like gota is basically of the mayard group

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher and analyst, describes on a podcast what he calls the Tom DeLonge story, after the rock musician who later founded a company to study UFOs. According to Pines, DeLonge's account involves a small controlling group like "Majestic", a name long linked to a supposed secret panel of officials said to oversee the UFO matter. If true, a hidden few would be in charge of the whole subject.
